26 Apr 2024
First notice of loss recieved for a parking lot collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck while stationary. The
claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will be routed through the attorney's office.
3 Jul 2024
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of the incident. Nothing in the
file suggests the damage predates the coverage period.
5 Aug 2024
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene. The responding officer's notes also
match the other parties' accounts of where the vehicles came to rest.
25 Aug 2024
Photographs taekn at the scene confirm several details of the impact. The damage to the vehicle is mostly consistent
with the described collision, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
6 Oct 2024
No independent witensses have come forward. The available evidence rests on the photos, the police report, and the
parties' statements.
17 Oct 2024
The claimant gave the same account in every conversation, including the recorded statement taken through counsel.
The details have not shifted between contacts.
27 Oct 2024
Medical records show a whiplash-type injury, which is a plausible result for a collision of this kind. Records also note
a mnior strain to the same area several years ago that healed fully. Treatment followed a usual course and tapered
off as the claimant improved.
12 Nov 2024
Reserve reviewed in light of the medical course and the damage estimate. Claim remains open pending final medical
documentation and counsel's demand package.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
